The '''Red Hydra Z-5''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. [[Red Hydra pistol]]s were once favored by [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[squad leader]]s in the military forces of the [[Quohag sector/Legends|Quohag sector]] until they were decommissioned by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] order.

Around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] a small company won the rights to produce a new line of Red Hydra pistols, the Red Hydra Z-5.
